summary: Stuart H. Blackburn is an Indologist who studied at Wesleyan University (~1968–1972) and the University of California, Berkeley (~1973–1980). He held a post at SOAS University of London from circa 1993 to 2011.
Stuart Henry Buck (1911–1997) was a Tibetologist who earned an A.B. at Harvard University (~1929–1933). He served as an intelligence analyst at the National Security Agency from circa 1952 to 1980.

Stuart Piggott (1910–1996) worked in archaeology and Indology, studying at Churcher's College and UCL Institute of Archaeology (~1934–1936). He held positions at Reading Museum (1927), Oxford (~1943–1946), and the University of Edinburgh as Professor of Archaeology (1948).

Stuart Ray Sarbacker is a scholar of religious studies, Indology, and philosophy. He earned his Ph.D. at the University of Wisconsin-Madison under David M. Knipe (2001) and has held posts at Northwestern, Wisconsin-Madison, Oregon State, and Vienna.

Su Bai (1922–2018) was a Chinese archaeologist, Buddhologist, and sinologist. He studied at Peking University (1940–1944) under Chengjun Feng, Zuoyun Sun, Rong Geng, and Yongtong Tang, and later served there as Professor from 1948 to 2004.

Subhadra Kumar Sen (1939–2009) was an Indian linguist and Indologist. He earned his degrees, including a PhD under Suniti Kumar Chatterji (~1968–1973), at the University of Calcutta, where he later served as Khaira Professor of Phonetics and Linguistics (~1979–2004).

Subhadradis Diskul (1923–2003) studied at Chulalongkorn, the École du Louvre under Philippe Stern, and the University of London. An archaeologist and art historian, he served as curator at Bangkok's National Museum, professor and rector at Silpakorn University, and SPAFA director.
Subhash Chandra works in computational linguistics and Indology. He completed his Ph.D. at Jawaharlal Nehru University (2007–2012) and serves as Professor at the University of Delhi (attested 2026).

Subhash Kak is an Indologist and engineer who earned his Ph.D. under Pavaguda V. Indiresan at IIT Delhi (~1967–1970). He has held professorships at Louisiana State University (1979) and Oklahoma State University (2007).

Subodhkant Mishra works in Indology and religious studies. He studied at Banaras Hindu University, the University of Delhi, and IGNOU, and held teaching posts at Shree Mahendra Das Degree College, Indus University, and the Central University of Punjab (2026).

Subrata K. Mitra (born 1949) studied at Utkal University, Delhi University, JNU, and the University of Rochester (Ph.D.). He served as Head of Political Science at Heidelberg University (1994–2014) and Director at the National University of Singapore (2015–2018).

Suchandra Ghosh works in history, archaeology, and Indology. She has held affiliations with the University of Canterbury (attested 2025) and The Asiatic Society as Professor (Special Invitee, attested 2026).
Sucharita Adluri is an Indologist and religious studies scholar who earned her PhD at the University of Pennsylvania. In 2009, she was appointed Professor at Cleveland State University.

Sucheng Chan (born 1941) is a historian who studied at Swarthmore College, the University of Hawaiʻi at Mānoa, and UC Berkeley. She served as an emerita professor at the University of California, Santa Barbara (~2002).
Sudan Shakya is a scholar in Buddhist studies and Indology. He has served as a professor at Shuchiin University (attested 2013–2026).

Sudarshan Chakradhari is a scholar of archaeology and Indology who completed his Ph.D. at Banaras Hindu University (2013–2019). In 2023, he joined Babasaheb Bhimrao Ambedkar University as an Assistant Professor.

Sudhir Kakar (1938–2024) studied at Gujarat University, Mannheim, Sigmund-Freud-Institut, and Vienna (doctorate). A scholar in religious studies and Indology, he taught at Harvard, IIM Ahmedabad, and IIT Delhi, alongside numerous international visiting professorships.

Sudhākara Dvivedī (1855–1910) was an Indologist who studied under Devakṛṣṇa. He succeeded Bapu Deva Sastri in 1889 and held posts as librarian and professor of mathematics and astrology at Sampurnanand Sanskrit University and Sanskrit College and University.

Sue Hamilton is a scholar of Buddhist studies, Indology, and philosophy. She earned her D.Phil at the University of Oxford under Alexis Sanderson and Richard Gombrich, later serving as Professor of Prehistory and Director at UCL (2014–2022).
Suehiro Tanemura (1933–2004) studied at the University of Tokyo (~1953–1957). He held academic posts at Tokyo Metropolitan University and Kokugakuin University (~1973–1998).
